```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)

here("R", ".setup.R") |> source()
```

## Overview

This document describes the data munging process used to create [PMTiles](https://docs.protomaps.com/pmtiles/) files for data sourced from the [`geodata`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/) R package [@hijmans2024].

## Methods

### Source of Data

The data used in this pipeline come from the following sources:

- [GADM](https://gadm.org/): Database of Global Administrative Areas
  - Data on administrative boundaries and regions, sourced via the [`geodata`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/) R package [@hijmans2024].
- [Uber Technologies](https://www.uber.com/):
  - Hexagonal grid data structured using the hexagonal hierarchical geospatial indexing system ([H3](https://h3geo.org/)) [@uber], processed with the [`h3r`](https://symbolixau.github.io/h3r) [@cooley2024] and [`h3jsr`](https://obrl-soil.github.io/h3jsr/) [@obrien2023] R packages.

### Data Munging

The data munging follow the data science workflow outlined by @wickham2023e, as illustrated in [@fig-wickham-at-al-2023-figure-1]. All processes were made using the [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) publishing system [@allaire], the [R](https://www.r-project.org/) programming language [@rcoreteam], and several R packages.

For data manipulation and workflow, priority was given to packages from the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/), [rOpenSci](https://ropensci.org/) and [r-spatial](https://r-spatial.org/) ecosystems, as well as other packages adhering to the tidy tools manifesto [@wickham2023c].

::: {#fig-wickham-at-al-2023-figure-1}
![](images/wickham-at-al-2023-figure-1.png){width=75%}

[Source: Reproduced from @wickham2023e.]{.legend}

Data science workflow created by Wickham, Çetinkaya-Runde, and Grolemund.
:::

### Code Style

The Tidyverse [tidy tools manifesto](https://tidyverse.tidyverse.org/articles/manifesto.html) [@wickham2023c], [code style guide](https://style.tidyverse.org/) [@wickhama] and [design principles](https://design.tidyverse.org/) [@wickhamc] were followed to ensure consistency and enhance readability.

### Reproducibility

The pipeline is fully reproducible and can be run again at any time. To ensure consistent results, the [`renv`](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/) package [@ushey2025] is used to manage and restore the R environment. See the [README](https://github.com/cem-usp/pmtilesbr/blob/main/README.md) file in the code repository to learn how to run it.

## Set the Environment

### Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: Set the Environment
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(fs)
library(h3jsr)
library(here)
library(geodata)
library(glue)
library(mapgl)
library(pmtiles) # github.com/walkerke/pmtiles
library(sf)
library(tidyr)
library(yyjsonr)
```

### Set Data Directories

```{r}
raw_data_dir <- here("data-raw")
data_dir <- here("pmtiles")
```

```{r}
for (i in c(data_dir, raw_data_dir)) {
  if (!dir_exists(i)) {
    dir_create(i, recurse = TRUE)
  }
}
```

### Set Initial Variables

::: {.callout-note}
The `country` variable specifies which country to retrieve. Use a three-letter country code that follows the [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) standard (e.g., `BRA`, `ITA`, or `USA`).
:::

```{r}
country <- "ARM"
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `level` variable specifies the level of detail of the data being retrieved. See [`world()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/world.html) and [`gadm()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/gadm.html) for more details on the available levels.
:::

```{r}
level <- 0
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `version` variable specifies the version of the data being retrieved. See [`world()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/world.html) and [`gadm()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/gadm.html) for more details on the available versions and their corresponding data updates.
:::

```{r}
version <- "latest"
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `resolution` variable specifies the resolution of the data being retrieved. See [`world()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/world.html) and [`gadm()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/gadm.html) for more details on the available resolutions and their corresponding levels of detail.
:::

```{r}
resolution <- 1
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `min_zoom` and `max_zoom` variables specify the minimum and maximum zoom levels for the PMTiles files. The zoom levels determine the level of detail and granularity of the data when visualized on a map. See [`pm_create()`](https://github.com/walkerke/pmtiles) for more details on how these parameters affect the PMTiles creation process.
:::

```{r}
min_zoom <- 2
```

```{r}
max_zoom <- 10
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `h3jsr` variable specifies whether to process the spatial data with the [`h3jsr`](https://obrl-soil.github.io/h3jsr/) R package, which converts spatial geometries into [H3](https://h3geo.org/) hexagonal grid cells. If `TRUE`, the `res` variable will define the resolution of the H3 grid.
:::

```{r}
h3jsr <- FALSE
```

::: {.callout-note}
The `res` variable specifies the resolution of the [H3 hexagonal grid](https://h3geo.org/). This only applies when using the [`h3jsr`](https://obrl-soil.github.io/h3jsr/) R package. See [`polygon_to_cells()`](https://obrl-soil.github.io/h3jsr/reference/polygon_to_cells.html) for more details on the available resolutions and their corresponding cell sizes.
:::

```{r}
res <- 9
```

## Download and Import Country Shape

```{r}
#| label: Download and Import Country Shape
#| eval: true

name <- "gadm"
```

```{r}
#| eval: true

shape <-
  gadm(
    country = country,
    level = level,
    path = raw_data_dir,
    version = version,
    resolution = resolution
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
#| eval: true

shape |> glimpse()
```

## Download and Import World Shapes

```{r}
#| label: Download and Import World Shapes
#| eval: false

name <- "world"
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

shape <-
  world(
    resolution = resolution,
    level = level,
    path = raw_data_dir,
    version = version
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

shape |> glimpse()
```

## Create PMTiles

### Transform Shapes

```{r}
#| label: Create PMTiles

shape <-
  shape |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
shape |> glimpse()
```

### Create PMTiles

#### Set Pattern

```{r}
if (isTRUE(h3jsr)) {
  pattern <- file.path(
    "geodata",
    name,
    "h3jsr",
    paste0("res-", res)
  )
} else {
  pattern <- file.path(
    "geodata",
    name
  )
}
```

```{r}
pattern <-
  pattern |>
  file.path(
    paste0(
      ifelse(
        name == "gadm",
        paste0("country", "-", country, "-"),
        ""
      ),
      # fmt: skip
      paste(
      "level", level,
      "version", version,
      "resolution", resolution,
      "min_zoom", min_zoom,
      "max_zoom", max_zoom,
      sep = "-"
    ),
      ".pmtiles"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pattern
```

```{r}
for (i in c(data_dir, tempdir())) {
  i |>
    file.path(pattern) |>
    dirname() |>
    dir_create(recurse = TRUE)
}
```

#### Process Shapes with `h3jsr`

```{r}
if (isTRUE(h3jsr)) {
  shape <-
    shape |>
    polygon_to_cells(res = res, simple = FALSE) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    unnest(h3_addresses) |>
    relocate(h3_addresses) |>
    cell_to_polygon(simple = FALSE) |>
    relocate(h3_address)
}
```

```{r}
shape |> glimpse()
```

#### Create PMTiles

```{r}
shape |>
  pm_create(
    output = tempdir() |> file.path(pattern),
    layer_name = name,
    min_zoom = min_zoom,
    max_zoom = max_zoom,
    description = glue(
      "Tiles sourced from the {backtick(name)} function of the ",
      "{backtick('geodata')} R package ",
      "(",
      ifelse(
        name == "gadm",
        paste0("country", " = ", double_quote(country), ", "),
        ""
      ),
      "level = {level}, ",
      "version = {double_quote(version)}, ",
      "resolution = {resolution}",
      ")",
      ifelse(
        isTRUE(h3jsr),
        " and processed with the {backtick('h3jsr')} R package (res = {res}). ",
        ". "
      ),
      "Created with the {backtick('pmtiles')} R package on {Sys.Date()}."
    )
  )
```

```{r}
tempdir() |>
  file.path(pattern) |>
  file_move(
    data_dir |>
      file.path(pattern)
  )
```

## Inspect PMTiles

```{r}
#| label: Inspect PMTiles
#| eval: false

data_dir |>
  file.path(pattern) |>
  pm_show(tilejson = TRUE)
```

## Visualize PMTiles

```{r}
#| label: Visualize PMTiles
#| eval: false

data_dir |>
  file.path(pattern) |>
  pm_view(port = 8080)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

pm_stop_server()
```
